message.reasoning:
I'm weighing whether to use my Get Out of Jail Free card now or stay put. With only $200 in cash and developed properties generating rent, staying in jail actually protects me—I collect income from my light blue hotels while avoiding landing on opponents' expensive properties. Gemini's also locked up, so I'm not at a disadvantage there.

The board doesn't have many developed monopolies threatening me, so the risk of landing on something costly is low. My best move is to roll for doubles on my next turn—it's a free attempt that costs nothing, and if I fail, I stay in jail anyway, which works in my favor. This way I preserve both my card and my cash while keeping my options open.
